description: What the About Redlines window may use: showing itself once its page is styled, being dragged by its background, and closing itself on Escape; and the three of the app's own commands its code calls, which say the name, version and build, which mark of the icon family the app's icon shows, and show another (the icon in the window changes as it is clicked). The app's own commands are granted one by one (build.rs lists them all), those its code calls and no others, as src/command-permissions.node.test.ts checks. It reads no file, nor the clipboard, and opens no dialog.
